style: Chinese xianxia 2D game character concept art, clean linework, cel shading and subtle ink wash accents, bright saturated colors, cute but majestic for elementary through high school. Pure white background. Exactly four separate full-body evolution stages left to right in a single wide horizontal row, increasing size and grandeur, same identity and palette. Clear gaps between stages, all anatomy and effects within frame. No words, letters, numbers, labels or watermark. Landscape about 3:1. Match the reference sheet's illustrative finish but do not copy dragon anatomy.
subjects: 02-baihu-evolution.png

White Tiger, snow white and gold. Stage1 round baby white tiger with pale black forehead stripes. Stage2 adolescent white tiger, deeper stripes, metallic golden claws. Stage3 majestic muscular white tiger in light armor, golden blade-light behind. Stage4 massive divine white tiger with luminous gold stripes, surrounding golden sword-energy. Four legs per tiger; no wings.
03-zhuque-evolution.png

Vermilion Bird, scarlet and orange gold. Stage1 round red chick, tiny flame-shaped crest. Stage2 adolescent firebird with growing tail feathers and sparks at wingtips. Stage3 elegant ornate vermilion phoenix with long flowing flame tail feathers. Stage4 majestic divine bird wings spread, body aflame and gold-red halo behind. Bird anatomy, only two wings and two legs each.
04-xuanwu-evolution.png

Black Tortoise Xuanwu, ink black deep blue bronze. Stage1 cute tiny turtle whose tail is a cute little snake. Stage2 adolescent turtle shell develops dark decorative patterns, snake winds around turtle. Stage3 huge heavy black-armored tortoise, black snake around its body, feet on small water waves. Stage4 island-like divine tortoise and snake united, deep blue currents and stars around it. Clearly readable turtle plus serpent anatomy at each stage.
05-qilin-evolution.png

Qilin, golden yellow and emerald green. Stage1 deer-like baby qilin with a single rounded horn and a few scales. Stage2 deer body with dragon scales, hooves on auspicious clouds. Stage3 proud qilin with golden scales and flame-shaped flowing mane. Stage4 radiant gold divine qilin standing on small five-colored auspicious clouds. Deer-like hooved anatomy throughout, recognizable consistent identity.
06-nine-tailed-fox-evolution.png

White celestial fox, snow white with blue violet foxfire. CRITICAL exact separate visible tails: first ONE tail, second THREE tails, third SIX tails, fourth NINE tails. Arrange tails as spacious distinct fan lobes with clear silhouettes and gaps, no tail-shaped stray wisps. Stage1 cute baby white fox with exactly1 tail, pale blue flame at tip. Stage2 adolescent fox with exactly3 tails. Stage3 elegant spirit fox with exactly6 tails and a very faint small ghostly face silhouette beside it (no extra body/tails). Stage4 majestic celestial fox with exactly9 long tails spread like a fan, blue violet foxfire nearby. Countable tails more important than ornament.
07-kunpeng-evolution.png

Kunpeng evolution from fish to great bird, deep ocean blue gradually sky cyan. Stage1 round chubby small fish, fins like little wings, bubbles around. Stage2 large fish, elongated pectoral fins half-fin half-wing, leaping out of a small water splash. Stage3 intermediate with clear fish body and large feathered bird wings, raising waves. Stage4 gigantic majestic roc bird, wings like clouds across sky, wingtip feathers retain iridescent fish-scale sheen. Preserve gradual fish-to-bird progression, not four unrelated animals.
08-baize-evolution.png

Baize wisdom beast, creamy white and pale gold. Stage1 lamb-like white baby beast, pair of small horns, intelligent big eyes. Stage2 lion-bodied creature with sheep horns and CLOSED third eye on forehead. Stage3 wise white beast with long whiskers, OPEN third eye on forehead, floating old scroll nearby. Stage4 sacred Baize surrounded by luminous scrolls with abstract diagram patterns only, absolutely no readable script. Four legs, consistent sheep horns/lion-body hybrid.
09-pixiu-evolution.png

Pixiu treasure beast, gold and jade green. Stage1 round baby lion-like pixiu, tiny wings, hugging one blank gold coin with no lettering. Stage2 adolescent pixiu with golden horns, a few gold ingots nearby. Stage3 robust pixiu with exactly two wings on its back, small treasure pile under feet. Stage4 majestic gold-and-jade divine beast with radiant treasure light. Cute to majestic, consistent leonine identity.
10-xiezhi-evolution.png

Xiezhi justice beast, dark blue-black and silver white. Exactly ONE central horn each stage. Stage1 small lamb-like baby with one short forehead horn. Stage2 youthful beast, horn longer, solemn upright expression. Stage3 imposing beast with dark cyan fur, single horn glowing white, one simple round mirror floating beside. Stage4 enormous divine beast, single horn radiating white light, large round mirror behind like sun. No extra horns, no lettering.
11-suanni-evolution.png

Suanni contemplative lion, warm gold and smoky gray. Stage1 cute lion cub with curly mane, exhaling one small smoke ring. Stage2 adolescent lion seated calmly in meditation pose, light smoke around. Stage3 majestic golden lion, smoke forms decorative cloud curls. Stage4 huge golden divine lion, luminous halo behind, rolling smoke clouds around feet. Real lion-like limbs/paws not human hands; peaceful confident presence.
12-kuiniu-evolution.png

Kui ox, blue gray and violet blue lightning. CRITICAL: every character has exactly ONE leg total, one single central supporting leg and one hoof, no other arms/legs, no hidden legs, no side limbs. Stage1 cute round one-legged ox calf, little electric sparks on horns. Stage2 adolescent one-legged ox with lightning patterns on body. Stage3 powerful ONE-legged ox with lightning at single hoof contact, war drum on its back. Stage4 majestic ONE-legged thunder ox god surrounded by purple-blue lightning, huge war drum suspended above clouds. Keep the single central leg fully exposed and easily counted in all four stages. Paired ox horns allowed; exactly one leg.
